description: This file contains unit tests for the EmploymentStatusDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, specifically testing CRUD operations and search functionalities related to EmploymentStatus entities.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmploymentStatusDao, testing methods such as retrieval, deletion, search, save, and update of employment status entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates DAO instance, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusesList
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO returns the correct number of employment status records.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a single EmploymentStatus by ID and asserts its name.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests deletion of employment statuses by IDs and verifies the number of records deleted.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests search functionality returning EmploymentStatus instances with default search parameters.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatusWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that search with limit returns correct number of records.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmploymentStatus object and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testEditEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests updating an existing EmploymentStatus and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatuses
methods.description: Ensures that the method to get all employment statuses returns the expected data.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Verifies that counting search results returns the expected total.
